empresas.descricao: Tech Lead and Fullstack Developer (.NET and Angular)
atividades: Acting as a Tech Lead in a team of 7 developers,
assisting the team in task development,
understanding the architecture, maintaining best practices
and company conventions, Code Reviews (Pull Request analysis),
leading ceremonies, and improvings in the
development workflow and processes. I also managed the
team’s blockers, solving them directly with other
departments or external companies. Developing in the
company's internal product, which dealt especially with
integrations with several external systems, using REST,
SOAP, and even RPA (automation) with Selenium,
and making them available for internal consumption
through proprietary APIs. Queuing was also implemented using Hangfire.
Main tools: .NET, SQL Server,
Azure DevOps, and AWS. Internal portal developed in Angular.
Temporary contract project.
Creation of the new intranet system of CICC-SP,
developing new features and maintaining existing ones.
Architecture focused on Clean Architecture and CQRS,
using ASP.NET, SQL Server, and Angular.
Development of new features, maintenance,
and bug fixes in SmartBus, a bus ticket sales
and management system, using ASP.NET
(framework 4.6, and versions 7 and 8), SQL Server,
Angular, and RabbitMQ, in a three-tier architecture
system (BLL, DAL, UI). I also acted as an architect,
where I was responsible for the creation of two
projects from scratch, both in architecture design
and coding, aiming at asynchronous processing of
high-volume batch data. The projects were created
to be the new standard models for the company’s
future projects. In them, I introduced new patterns
and technologies to the company, implementing
integration with queuing using RabbitMQ, logs in
ElasticSearch using Serilog, Result Pattern for
error handling, and new architecture patterns,
both using Clean Architecture, and one of them, CQRS.
The new systems also represented significant
improvement in the multitenant implementation
compared to the previous one, with a redesigned
solution from scratch, making the database
connection dynamic according to the selected client.
Backend development using ASP.NET 6, SQL Server, MongoDB,
RabbitMQ and NodeJS, among other technologies, in a
microservices architecture with CQRS. Worked on the
project to rewrite the São Paulo Official Gazette from scratch.
Participated in the creation of some .NET projects,
and notably, was responsible for the creation from
scratch of a project in NodeJS, using RabbitMQ queues
and Clean Architecture.
Development of new features, maintenance and bug fixing
in Radar, the company's main system, which provides
various management tools for partner entrepreneurs.
Radar included features such as registration of partners
and products, marketing campaign management, and even a
small embedded e-commerce. We mainly used ASP.NET Core
in the APIs, Angular for the frontends and MySQL as the
database, in addition to other surrounding technologies.
I also helped implement queues using RabbitMQ and was
responsible for the full development of several epics
from end to end as a fullstack.
Maintenance, analysis and bug fixing, implementation
of new features in .NET Core APIs, with CQRS,
SQL Server and integration with other systems.
I also helped implement process queuing with RabbitMQ.
I worked in the Corporate Charges squad/microservice,
and acted as the team’s Security Champion, an essential
role in integration with the Information Security squad,
of which I was also a part, helping the team to promote
better security practices and correct possible vulnerabilities.
Had a strong role in PDF slip generation and in the
complete rewriting of CNAB generation to support
igh-volume batch data processing.
I was one of the developers responsible for migration
and enhancement (complete code rewriting) of a legacy
internal MPA system (old ASP.NET MVC) to SPA with
Angular and .NET Core. The project consisted of a
control and management system for scripts and routines
requested by non-privileged users. The frontend was
redesigned for a better and more user-friendly and
aesthetically pleasing interface, and the backend was
refactored to meet the new frontend and be replaced
by the .NET Core version. Integration tests were
performed using Selenium. It was a temporary contract
that ended when the allocated hours were used up.
I was responsible for developing the front-end of the
National Customer Registry, a crucial internal system
undergoing a complete rewrite to allow various types
of queries across the entire customer database.
I designed the frontend architecture from scratch,
including both the programming logic and layout,
and coded most of it until my departure. I did not
work on the backend in this project.

empresas.descricao: Developer in .Net, .Net Core, AngularJS, Angular, and NodeJS.
atividades: Development of new features and bug fixes in the
company's systems. The main system was a personal
loan offer comparison platform, developed using .Net,
Angular, and AngularJS. A migration to .Net Core was
in progress. Other internal projects also used
technologies such as NodeJS and Python. I also worked
on creating queries for MongoDB and managing the
execution of some RPA processes built with Selenium.

empresas.descricao: Developer in .Net, .Net Core, AngularJS, and Angular
atividades: Consultancy and system development using ASP.NET
(Framework and Core), C#, SQL Server, AngularJS,
and Angular. As part of a software development
outsourcing company, I participated in the development
of several products from start to finish as a full-stack
.NET + Angular developer, also contributing to entity
modeling. Among these projects, highlights include
the post-sale control system for SalfaCorp, a major
engineering firm in Chile, an online course system,
and another complete evaluation system that allowed
for exam creation with various question types,
automatic correction for objective questions,
and teacher evaluation for subjective questions.
In-person placement in Santiago, Chile.
I worked on developing the company’s main proprietary product,
Gepro, a system that generated reports and flagged potential
inconsistencies in the databases of major insurers in Brazil,
and Portal do Corretor (Broker Portal), an internal system for
Brasil Brokers company. In this systems, which were built using
Asp.net Webforms, Crystal Reports, and MS SQL Server, I gained
extensive experience in creating and maintaining stored procedures,
which served as the source for many Crystal reports.
Main technologies used: Asp.net, C#, and SQL Server.
Later, I worked on the Portal do Corretor (Broker Portal),
an internal system for Brasil Brokers company, used by brokers
and internal administration, where properties and clients were registered,
including potential customers with their interests and sales.
This was the project to which I dedicated the most time in the company.
Occasionally, I also assisted on the Brasil Brokers website from another team.
Additionally, I contributed to the initial development
of Girus, a new system similar to Gepro, for reinsurance.
My responsibilities included error analysis, new module and
feature development, requirements gathering with clients,
and documentation writing. Main technologies used: Asp.net, C#, and SQL Server.
Error analysis and resolution, assistance in developing
new systems, documentation writing, and manual testing.
Main technologies used: Asp.net, C#, and SQL Server.
The main client I worked for was Cultura Inglesa, where
I contributed to the development of a distance learning
portal (online courses) and maintenance of an Asp Classic system.

textoExtra: In addition to the experiences listed above, prior to these,
I completed two other internships as a developer, worked
twice in technical support, worked as a computer maintenance technician
at Caixa Econômica (brazilian public bank), and my first job
was as a call center agent for Tim, at the age of 18.
